rule: All OI/funding observations must be mapped to the same 4h candle grid used by local OHLCV validation.
failure_if_violated: Cannot compare with prior validation windows or detect leakage.

rule: A feature value may only be attached to a 4h candle if it was observable at or before that candle close.
failure_if_violated: Data unusable for strategy research until corrected.

rule: Funding typically updates at a lower frequency such as 8h; future audit must record whether rate is historical settled, current, or predicted and define candle assignment before validation.
failure_if_violated: Funding data is partially usable at best; strategy definition forbidden.

rule: Open interest sampling frequency must be documented. If higher than 4h, aggregate by last-known-observable within candle; if lower than 4h, document sparse coverage without unapproved forward-fill.
failure_if_violated: OI feature cannot be used as a precise 4h signal.

rule: Do not forward-fill missing OI/funding values by default. Any future fill policy must be separately studied and documented before validation.
failure_if_violated: Risk of fabricated continuity; data not usable for primary validation.

rule: All source timestamps must be normalized to UTC and compared against OHLCV UTC timestamps.
failure_if_violated: Data unusable until timestamp normalization is fixed.

rule: Audit must report coverage for all 19 prior markets and keep BTCUSDT, DOGEUSDT, DOTUSDT, and UNIUSDT visible.
failure_if_violated: Coverage cannot support fair continuation of this research chain.

rule: If a swap/perpetual instrument is missing for a market, document it; do not replace the market with a different symbol.
